workflow_runs.name: CLA Assistant
workflow_runs.display_title: API key containing letter Q cannot be entered because Codex CLI interprets Q as a quit command

head_commit.message:
fix: dont quit on 'q' in onboarding ApiKeyEntry state (#7869)

### What

Don't treat `q` as a special quit character on the API key paste page in
the onboarding flow.

This addresses #7413, where pasting API keys with `q` would cause codex
to quit on Windows.

### Test Plan

Tested on Windows and MacOS.
